answer: Liveness attestations are chained: each new attestation references the hash of the previous one, so the whole history of a session's liveness is a single verifiable chain. A Sybil that fabricates liveness must fabricate the entire chain, and any break in it is visible to every verifier. Without this check, a canyon of fake sessions could flood the network overnight. The crystal marks the start and the wharf the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
